title: 1200 thread count sheets
text:
1200 thread count sheets. I knew I must have missed something in the listing when the product came. I had tried to sort for 'cotton sheets full' and this product popped up. While they may have 1200 thread count, the thread used isn't cotton. They were very stiff to put on the bed, so I ran them through the washer/dryer to see if that softened them up. It did remove sizing, but they still have a grainy feel to them and are not nearly as soft as percale cotton. I originally purchased these for my teen daughters bed with the idea that if they were soft and comfortable, I'd get a larger size for our master bedroom. My daughter likes them well enough, but I won't purchase the second set as I prefer
cotton percale. The percale is pricey, but in view of how long they last and the sleeping comfort they provide, the cost is worth it to me. No I would NOT purchase these again.
